meta.name: depmap
meta.description: Query the Cancer Dependency Map (DepMap) for cancer cell line gene dependency scores (CRISPR Chronos), drug sensitivity data, and gene effect profiles. Use for identifying cancer-specific vulnerabilities, synthetic lethal interactions, and validating oncology drug targets.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询癌症依赖图谱数据，发现肿瘤靶点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在癌症研究中使用DepMap数据筛选基因依赖或药物敏感性。
copy.tagline_en: Query cancer dependency map data to discover tumor targets.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze cancer gene dependencies or drug sensitivity data from DepMap.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会查询 DepMap 的癌症细胞系 CRISPR 依赖分数、药物敏感性和基因效应谱,并输出某个基因的依赖株列表、突变与依赖的统计检验、共必需基因排行等结果。
howto.when: 当用户提出评估基因在特定癌种中的必需性、寻找合成致死基因、验证药物靶点,或分析突变与依赖相关性等任务时触发。

say.text: 查一下 KRAS 基因在肺癌细胞系里的 Chronos 依赖分数
say.note: 返回各细胞系的依赖分数并筛出依赖株。

say.text: 分析 BRCA1 突变是否预测对 PARP1 的依赖
say.note: 对突变与野生型细胞系做统计检验。

say.text: 找出与 MYC 共必需的前 20 个基因
say.note: 返回依赖谱相关性最高的基因。

howto.what_en: After setup, Claude can query DepMap APIs or local files for CRISPR dependency scores, drug sensitivity, and gene effect profiles, enabling target validation, synthetic lethality, biomarker, and co-essentiality analyses.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to assess a gene's essentiality in a specific cancer type, find synthetic lethal partners, validate an oncology drug target, or analyze mutation–dependency associations.

say_en.text: Check the Chronos dependency score of KRAS in lung cancer cell lines.
say_en.note: Returns per-cell-line scores and filters dependent lines.

say_en.text: Analyze whether BRCA1 mutation predicts dependency on PARP1.
say_en.note: Compares mutated vs wild-type lines with a statistical test.

say_en.text: Find the top 20 genes co-essential with MYC.
say_en.note: Returns genes with most correlated dependency profiles.
